stages.title: 一、建立系統邊界與輸入帳
stages.titleEn: 1. Define the system boundary and input ledger
stages.description: 閱讀來源 IEEE 802.11 Wireless LAN standards working group，找出本課機制與適用範圍。以自己的圖解標示：聚合可攤提前導與競爭時間，但每個子框仍有標頭與錯誤邊界；必須保留Block ACK的子框狀態。 將輸入逐項抄入有單位的表：每子框1000 byte payload、40 byte overhead，固定每聚合200 byte等效開銷；比較1與10子框。 對每個量註明固定、改變、推導或未建模；將引用內容與教學假設分欄。
stages.descriptionEn: Read IEEE 802.11 Wireless LAN standards working group to locate the mechanism and its scope. Draw your own model boundary: Aggregation amortizes preamble/contention while retaining per-subframe overhead and error boundaries; keep Block ACK subframe outcomes. Transcribe the inputs into a unit-bearing ledger: Each subframe has1000 payload bytes and40 overhead bytes; fixed aggregate overhead is200 equivalent bytes; compare1 and10 subframes. Label each quantity fixed, changed, derived or unmodelled, separating sourced concepts from teaching assumptions.
